title: Name a computed column
prompt: For every product, return its name and stock_value: its price multiplied by its stock. The starter computes the values, but the second column has no name. Name it stock_value.
hints: Look at the header of the starter's result. What is the second column called?
AS goes right after the expression it names.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Names the column something other than what was asked.
Adds the price and the stock instead of multiplying them.

feedback: Check the header first: the two columns must be name and stock_value. Then work one row out by hand.
